requests.note: I need the rigging schedule for the stage plan.

messages.author: M-01
messages.text: Morning all. From this week, please log every blocker on the task itself so it shows up on the Blocked board — not only in chat.

messages.author: M-01
messages.text: Aurora Gala is 3 weeks out. <@M-02> <@M-04> please review open items with your teams on Monday.

messages.author: M-04
messages.text: Heads-up: <#T-309> will slip unless the venue sends the ceiling drawings this week.

messages.author: M-01
messages.text: I’ll call the venue GM today.

messages.author: M-02
messages.text: Client confirmed the stage layout. Run-of-show v3 in progress — <#T-101>.

messages.author: M-05
messages.text: Noted. I’ll share a draft with <@M-10> for the seating side by Friday.

messages.author: M-10
messages.text: Seating plan submitted for approval: <#T-103>

messages.author: M-06
messages.text: Still no logo files from Aurora. Marked <#T-102> as blocked.

messages.author: M-04
messages.text: <@M-06> thanks — I’ve asked <@M-02> to chase the client comms team.

messages.author: M-02
messages.text: Catering needs a headcount. We can’t lock it until RSVP closes on 1 Aug — see <#T-108>.

messages.author: M-03
messages.text: Sent back the arch render — too tall for the pendopo. <@M-09> please keep it under 3 m.

messages.author: M-09
messages.text: On it, will resubmit by Wednesday.

messages.author: M-08
messages.text: Moodboard rev 2 is up for approval: <#T-201>. Warmer palette as the family asked.

messages.author: M-03
messages.text: Keynote concept is in <#T-301>. Feedback welcome before I pass it to Agus.

messages.author: M-07
messages.text: Three streaming vendors shortlisted so far. Will add the quotes to <#T-302>.

messages.author: M-09
messages.text: Wayfinding is taking longer than planned — the floor plan changed. <@M-03> can we move the deadline?

messages.author: M-05
messages.text: Survey results are in: 4.2 / 5 overall. Full summary attached to <#T-401>.

messages.author: M-05
messages.text: Venue can hold the catering order until 3 Aug if we send a provisional count now — I’ll send 220.

messages.author: M-02
messages.text: Video call · 18 min · Dinda A., Rina M., Hendra T.

messages.author: M-03
messages.text: Video call · 12 min · Maya S., Putri L., Kevin W.

messages.author: M-01
messages.text: Rina, great work on the run-of-show. Can you take the client walkthrough on Tuesday?

messages.author: M-05
messages.text: Yes, happy to. I’ll bring the seating draft too.

messages.author: M-02
messages.text: Quick one — are you free for a call at 10 about the stage manager brief?

messages.author: M-03
messages.text: Yes — take until 30 Jul, and log the floor-plan change on the task.

messages.author: M-01
messages.text: Welcome to #general — for everyday questions and chat. #announcements stays for company news. The Lounge voice channel is open any time.

transcript.speaker: M-02
transcript.text: Thanks for joining. Quick agenda: where we are on Aurora Bank Annual Gala, open issues, and next steps.

transcript.speaker: M-05
transcript.text: From my side the run-of-show draft is ready, but the timings for the second half are still rough.

transcript.speaker: M-02
transcript.text: What is blocking the second half?

transcript.speaker: M-05
transcript.text: We are waiting on the venue for the load-in window. They promised it this week.

transcript.speaker: M-04
transcript.text: Rigging needs that window too — without it we can’t book the crew.

transcript.speaker: M-02
transcript.text: Agreed: we lock the load-in window before we book anything else.

transcript.speaker: M-04
transcript.text: I’ll call the venue manager tomorrow morning and get it in writing.

transcript.speaker: M-02
transcript.text: Catering asked for a final headcount. RSVPs are at about seventy percent.

transcript.speaker: M-02
transcript.text: Then we send a reminder to everyone who hasn’t answered.

transcript.speaker: M-02
transcript.text: I’ll send the RSVP reminder by Friday.

transcript.speaker: M-05
transcript.text: Budget-wise we are on track, but the lighting quote came in ten percent higher.

transcript.speaker: M-02
transcript.text: Decision: we keep the current lighting vendor and ask for a revised quote.

transcript.speaker: M-05
transcript.text: Can you send me the old quote so I can compare?

transcript.speaker: M-02
transcript.text: Yes — I’ll share the old lighting quote in the channel after this call.

transcript.speaker: M-04
transcript.text: One more thing: the client wants a walkthrough next week.

transcript.speaker: M-02
transcript.text: Let’s go with Tuesday afternoon for the client walkthrough.

transcript.speaker: M-05
transcript.text: I’ll prepare the walkthrough deck by Monday.

transcript.speaker: M-02
transcript.text: Good. Anything else? … Then that’s it — thanks, everyone.

notes.text: Venue load-in window still unconfirmed — get it in writing.

summary.overview: The team met for 18 minutes to review Aurora Bank Annual Gala, covering run-of-show, venue, rigging, catering, budget and client. They agreed to lock the load-in window before booking anything else and send a reminder to every guest who has not answered yet. 4 follow-ups were assigned to Hendra T., Dinda A. and Rina M.
agenda: Progress on Aurora Bank Annual Gala
discussion: Run-of-show: the draft is ready; timings for the second half still need work.
Venue: the load-in window is still unconfirmed, which holds up the second half.
Rigging: crew booking depends on the same load-in window.
Catering: a final headcount is needed; RSVPs stand at about 70%.
Budget: on track overall, but the lighting quote came in 10% higher.
Client: a walkthrough has been requested for next week.
Noted during the call (Rina M.): Venue load-in window still unconfirmed — get it in writing.
decisions: Lock the load-in window before booking anything else.
Send a reminder to every guest who has not answered yet.
Keep the current lighting vendor and ask for a revised quote.
Hold the client walkthrough on Tuesday afternoon.

action_items.text: Confirm the load-in window with the venue manager, in writing
Send the RSVP reminder to guests who have not answered
Share the previous lighting quote in the channel for comparison
Prepare the deck for the client walkthrough
